items.title: Last night, Paul George made his 2,500th career 3-pointer, becoming only the 8th player in history to reach that mark.
items.author: NBA Stat
items.body_excerpt:
Last night, Paul George made his 2,500th career 3-pointer, becoming only the 8th player in history to reach that mark.

He also became the 5th-fastest player to reach 2,500 3P, doing so in 960 games. Only Stephen Curry, Klay Thompson, Damian Lillard and James Harden got there in fewer games.

#NBA
